summary: Clean on the MEM dimension. proxy.py is pure-Python metaprogramming that emits numba source for an @intrinsic + @njit wrapper; it performs no NRT incref/decref, holds no raw pointers, defines no @cfunc, and does no struct-by-value ABI work. The single codegen op is builder.call(f, args) where f is an extern function resolved by symbol name (llvm_cfunc_wrapper_name), i.e. the cache-safe extern-ref-by-name pattern with no literal address baked in. The .as_func / CompileResultWAP handle and the absence of a func_jit keep-alive reference are the documented known-correct lifetime pattern (numba pins compiled code globally; dispatcher GC does not reclaim the JIT'd symbol), so they are not memory defects.
